topics.title: 隐私与数据
topics.summary: 教职员工不应将学生提交物或可识别的学生作品上传至外部生成式 AI 工具。
topics.scope: 适用于处理学生作品的教职员工；不能替代全部学生或科研数据分类规则。

claims.text: Staff should not upload student submissions or identifiable student work to external GenAI tools.

evidence.quote: Staff should not upload student submissions or identifiable student work to external GenAI tools.
evidence.title: Generative AI in Learning and Teaching

topics.evidenceScope: Staff handling student work; this is not a complete classification of all student or research data.

topics.title: 机构工具
topics.summary: Cardiff 列出 Copilot、Gemini 和 NotebookLM，供师生通过大学账户使用；考核许可须另行确认。
topics.scope: 机构账户访问范围；未实测个人账户开通及费用。

claims.text: Cardiff lists Copilot, Gemini and NotebookLM as institutionally available to staff and students through university accounts. Assessment permission is separate.

evidence.quote: For Cardiff staff and students, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini and NotebookLM are institutionally available GenAI tools. University accounts should be used to access these platforms, as they align with Cardiff University’s institutional security standards, handle data appropriately, and are approved for use within Cardiff’s digital tool environment.
evidence.title: Generative AI in Learning and Teaching

topics.evidenceScope: Institutional account access; individual activation and prices have not been tested.

topics.title: 研究与发表
topics.summary: 图书馆认为 Copilot 可辅助确定文献检索主题或研究问题；这不构成论文发表或学位论文规则。
topics.scope: 仅为文献检索指引，不是全校作者署名政策。

claims.text: Library guidance describes Copilot as potentially useful for defining a literature-search topic or research question. It does not establish publication or thesis rules.

evidence.quote: Generative AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot can be helpful when you need to identify a topic to research and/or define a research question.
evidence.title: Using Gen AI to support your literature searching
evidence.location: Introductory guidance; SHA256 refers to excerpt file; not original source bytes.

topics.evidenceScope: Literature searching guidance, not a university-wide authorship policy.

additionalTopics.title: 学术诚信
additionalTopics.summary: 学生应遵守学术规范，涉嫌违规须按对应程序处理；只有原程序赋予复核权时才适用大学复核程序。
additionalTopics.scope: 一般学术诚信框架。若大学复核程序适用，其期限从决定发出之日计算；须先核对原程序。

claims.text: Students are expected to maintain academic standards; allegations follow the relevant misconduct procedure. A review is available only where the originating procedure provides that right.

evidence.quote: A student is expected to maintain high standards of academic practice and not engage in academic misconduct. The relevant Academic Misconduct Procedure will be applied to any student where concerns are raised that they have not followed the appropriate academic procedures or standards, and are alleged to have engaged in academic misconduct.
evidence.title: Academic Integrity Policy (August 2022)
evidence.location: Introduction 1.1–1.2; SHA256 refers to excerpt file; not original source bytes.

claims.text: Students are expected to maintain academic standards; allegations follow the relevant misconduct procedure. A review is available only where the originating procedure provides that right.
